title: Attribute the full-rebuild compiler envelope without a second projection path

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Extend the existing GPU-100 relation-delta diagnostic, not production, so the unchanged compile_relation_blocks call is profiled directly. Attribute its real selected TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed reconstruction call and report the remaining compiler cumulative envelope as a bounded non-block residual. Keep the residual explicitly broader than pure edge discovery because it also contains Forest/Fourfold partition checks, edge admission, fact aggregation, signature/axis setup and receipt construction. Do not build or simulate an incremental backend.

attribution_contract.ordinary_timing: GPU-100 base/delta compile medians remain ordinary unprofiled compile_relation_blocks wall timings.
attribution_contract.profiled_subject: Only the delta full rebuild is profiled after ordinary timing. Every profiled result must retain the exact delta CompiledRelationBlocks digest.
attribution_contract.compiler_total: cProfile cumulative/self attribution for the existing compile_relation_blocks code object.
attribution_contract.selected_block_reconstruction: cProfile cumulative/self attribution for the real TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed call made by the compiler; no replacement constructor is invoked.
attribution_contract.non_block_residual: max(0, compile_relation_blocks cumulative - TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed cumulative). This is a bounded compiler-envelope residual, not a pure edge-scan wall-time measurement.
attribution_contract.profile_repeats: bounded exact-int range 1..5 with default 3; bool aliases are refused.
attribution_contract.claim_boundary: Profiled timings are diagnostic and distorted by profiling. They are not additive to ordinary wall medians and do not establish an incremental, memory, Tensor-vs-Forest or GPU win.

semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest/Fourfold remain authoritative; the diagnostic never becomes a graph or fact owner.
semantic_invariants.projection_owner: compile_relation_blocks remains unchanged and is the only projection owner used for base, delta, profiled delta and partial-plane refusal cases.
semantic_invariants.closed_world: Selected relation endpoint planes remain complete; partial code remains refused before sparse zero interpretation.
semantic_invariants.fixed_axes: The GPU-100 fixed-axis one-coordinate delta fixture is retained unchanged.
semantic_invariants.canonical_output: Each profiled compile must have the exact digest of the ordinary delta compile.
semantic_invariants.bounded_memory: The profiler is bounded to at most five sequential samples and retains only compact aggregate metrics in the report.
semantic_invariants.public_api: No public API, wire schema outside the diagnostic report, production authority or promotion contract changes.
